rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING AND ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE DISABLED PERSONS AUTHORITY, DEFINING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIE S, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Philippine Disabled Persons Authority Act".  The proposed Authority shall be an independent and autonomous body to be attached to the Office of the President as any national government agency.  It shall provide direct and specific services in the implementation of government policies and programs for the rehabilitation and development of the disabled.
